papers.title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.
papers.summary_cn: Demiurge针对现有新视角视频生成方法逐条独立处理相机轨迹、难以保持跨视角一致性的问题，提出基于动态4D点云记忆的自回归视频重渲染框架。它通过“生成—恢复—更新”循环，将生成的外观和恢复的几何持续写入共享记忆，并结合记忆引导的外观扩散、记忆一致的视频深度补全、双流变形和几何感知细化，实现连贯的多视角时空世界构建。实验显示，该方法在视频质量、跨轨迹一致性、相机轨迹跟随、大视差重渲染和3D高斯泼溅重建方面优于所比较的方法。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出基于动态4D点云记忆的自回归视频重渲染框架，用于构建跨相机轨迹一致且可导航的4D世界。2. 提出记忆引导的外观视频扩散模型，并通过噪声监测器抑制点云投影中的异常条件。3. 提出记忆一致的视频深度补全方法，将缓存几何与新揭示区域结合，恢复时序一致且具有度量尺度的深度。4. 提出记忆感知的双流变形策略，分别维护外观记忆和几何记忆，以兼顾颜色稳定性与遮挡推理能力，减少背景泄漏和累积色彩漂移。5. 提出可选的几何感知视频细化模块，以降低纹理闪烁和高频噪声。6. 通过大量实验验证了密集多视角时空晶格构建、大视差重渲染以及几何忠实3D高斯泼溅重建能力。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点高度相关。该方法直接属于视频扩散和视频重渲染领域，并以自回归方式沿连续相机轨迹生成新视角视频。动态4D点云记忆使历史观测能够跨轨迹复用，缓解长视界生成中的上下文遗忘、空间漂移和外观漂移问题；双流变形和记忆更新机制则为闭环式世界状态维护提供了显式几何基础。它面向可导航4D世界、具身智能和机器人仿真，因而与动作条件视觉世界模型和闭环模拟具有明确联系，但论文主要条件是相机轨迹，而不是智能体动作或环境交互策略。论文使用视频扩散模型和显式缓存复用，但未重点研究实时生成、蒸馏或稀疏注意力。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文未明确系统列出局限性，但根据方法和实验设置可确认以下限制：输入仍是单目视频，未观测区域需要由生成模型补全，因此无法保证真实世界几何和动态的完全准确性；自回归记忆更新可能累积生成误差、伪影或错误几何。实验主要使用81帧、480×832分辨率的视频片段，并依赖Wan2.1-1.3B等扩散模型和8张NVIDIA H20 GPU，计算成本较高，论文未证明其实时性能。方法需要已知或估计的相机轨迹，论文没有展示由智能体动作直接驱动的闭环交互控制。论文未明确说明在更长时序、更复杂动态场景、极端遮挡或大规模环境中的性能上限。
papers.abstract_cn: 近年来，视频扩散模型的发展显著推动了生成式视频重渲染：模型可以从单个输入视频合成新视角视频，从而服务于世界建模、具身智能和机器人仿真等广泛应用。然而，尽管现有方法具有出色的照片级真实感，它们通常将每条相机轨迹孤立处理，缺乏构建连贯且可遍历的四维世界所需的跨轨迹一致性。为解决这一局限，我们提出Demiurge，一种用于生成可导航四维世界的自回归视频重渲染流程。Demiurge建立在动态四维点云记忆缓存之上，通过四个关键组件促进跨轨迹一致性：1）外观视频扩散模型，以四维记忆为条件，沿目标相机轨迹重渲染具有照片级真实感的新视角视频；2）记忆一致的视频深度补全模型，使已知区域的深度与缓存几何对齐，同时补全缺失区域，从而缓解记忆更新过程中的尺度歧义和不连续性；3）记忆感知的双流变形策略，为新视角视频合成提供高保真的视觉引导和遮挡线索；4）几何感知的视频细化模型，进一步提升合成视频的感知质量。大量实验表明，Demiurge达到了当前最优性能，并具备三项关键能力：1）在密集的多视角轨迹上构建连贯的时空晶格；2）在具有挑战性的相机运动下进行大视差视频重渲染，包括在与输入视角完全没有重叠的情况下完成180度旋转；3）生成几何忠实的输出，这些输出可以直接优化为高质量的3D高斯泼溅表示，并且伪影极少。项目主页：https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/。

papers.title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对自回归视频扩散模型中 KV 缓存随视频时长线性增长、严重占用 GPU 内存的问题，提出免训练的 TempoKV 预测式量化方法。作者发现，键缓存能够由同一空间位置的历史键有效预测，而值缓存的主要预测信号是当前对齐的键，历史值仅提供有限补充信息。TempoKV 先预测并量化键残差，再利用重建的当前键和历史值预测并量化值残差，同时为键分配更高精度。预测器通过少量 BF16 校准轨迹离线线性回归得到，无需重新训练模型。其在三种自回归视频模型上的实验显示，TempoKV 在视觉质量、长时一致性、压缩率、显存和延迟之间取得了优于基线的平衡，最高实现 6.71 倍 KV 缓存压缩，并支持约 90 秒的长视频生成。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 揭示视频 KV 缓存中键和值的非对称时序预测关系：键主要依赖自身历史，值则显著受当前对齐键的影响，并通过分层及时序分析验证该规律。2. 提出 TempoKV 预测式残差量化框架，分别预测键和值，仅量化低幅度残差，并采用键高精度、值低精度的混合位宽分配。3. 设计轻量、免训练的离线线性回归校准方法，预测器可跨提示词和生成运行复用。4. 在 Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing 和 LongCat-Video-13B 上验证方法有效性，在最高 6.71 倍压缩下保持较高生成质量，并降低 KV 缓存和峰值显存开销。5. 通过交叉预测器、混合位宽和历史长度消融实验，验证了键到值预测、较高键精度以及短值历史和较长键历史的设计。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点高度相关。它直接面向自回归、流式和长视频生成中的 KV 缓存瓶颈，通过利用跨潜在帧的时序冗余压缩历史上下文，降低长时生成所需的显存。方法无需训练，在线解码仅引入较小延迟，适合实时或近实时生成优化；在 Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing 等因果视频生成框架上的验证也与闭环、持续上下文复用密切相关。论文重点是缓存量化和预测式残差编码，而不是动作条件建模、世界模型或闭环控制本身。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文是预印本，且实验主要基于 Self-Forcing-Wan-1.3B、Causal Forcing-Wan-1.3B 和 LongCat-Video-13B，以及 MovieGen 的前 128 个提示词，模型和数据覆盖范围有限。预测器需要离线收集 BF16 校准轨迹，并依赖训练模型中稳定的空间索引和跨帧统计规律，其对其他架构、任务或分布外提示词的泛化能力未被充分验证。实验主要考察 KV 缓存压缩对生成质量、显存和延迟的影响，没有系统报告端到端实时帧率或更广泛的硬件结果。极低精度下性能可能明显下降：值使用 1 bit 时质量显著崩溃。论文未明确说明代码发布后的可复现性、不同校准集规模的敏感性，以及在动作条件视觉世界模型或闭环交互场景中的表现。
papers.abstract_cn: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型能够流式生成长视频，但由于 KV 缓存快速增长而面临显著的内存开销。现有 KV 缓存量化方法主要针对大语言模型设计，迁移到视频模型时效果不佳，因为视频模型中的激活具有不同的统计特征和强烈的时空冗余。我们观察到，视频 KV 缓存随时间具有很强的可预测性，并呈现明显的不对称性：键可以根据其时间历史高度准确地预测，而值主要依赖当前键，并且只需要较短的前序值历史。基于这些观察，我们提出 TempoKV，一种面向 AR 视频生成的免训练预测式 KV 缓存量化框架。TempoKV 根据键和值各自不同的依赖关系进行预测，并仅以低精度存储预测残差。两个预测器都很轻量，仅通过在少量 BF16 样本上进行线性回归离线校准一次，并在不同提示词和生成运行之间保持固定。在 Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing 和 LongCat-Video-13B 上的实验表明，在相当或更高压缩比下，TempoKV 始终比现有 KV 缓存量化方法实现更高的生成质量；其 KV 缓存压缩比最高达到 6.71 倍，并取得了最佳的整体质量—效率权衡。我们的代码将发布在 GitHub 上。

papers.title: AnyRank: Reliable Anytime Policy Ranking via Sequential Testing
papers.abstract: Due to the high cost of hardware experiments, robot policies are predominantly evaluated by comparing their empirical performance on a limited number of hardware trials. However, finite-sample statistical uncertainty can lead to erroneous conclusions, especially when ranking multiple policies using a fixed batch of evaluation data. We propose AnyRank: a sequential method for multi-policy ranking that (i) adaptively allocates trials to hard-to-separate policies, (ii) provides (partial) rankings at any stopping time while bounding the probability of an incorrect ranking, and (iii) optionally exploits prior information to prioritize hardware evaluations more efficiently. This prior information could be informed from expert intuition, a small set of held-out hardware evaluations, or from policy rollouts in a simulator or an action-conditioned video world model. Notably, the prior can be imperfect; while a strong prior can provide efficiency gains on hardware, any inaccuracies in prior policy rankings do not invalidate the statistical assurances of AnyRank. We achieve the aforementioned properties through novel theoretical contributions that combine sequential testing with multiple-hypothesis graphical testing approaches. Experiments in simulation and real-world policy evaluation benchmarks show that AnyRank requires up to 50% fewer hardware evaluations compared to existing statistically rigorous approaches, while guarding against the incorrect rankings produced by heuristic methods used by state-of-the-art benchmarks.
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 AnyRank，用于在硬件试验次数有限且成本高昂的情况下可靠地对多个机器人策略进行排序。该方法将策略排序建模为多重假设检验问题，结合安全的任意时刻有效推断、序贯的非参数两两比较和图式多重检验。它根据当前证据自适应选择下一个要评估的策略，并动态重新分配统计风险预算，从而优先处理难以区分的策略，同时在任意停止时刻控制家族错误率并输出完整或部分排序。AnyRank还可利用来自专家、留出硬件数据、模拟器或动作条件视频世界模型的先验；即使先验错误，也不会破坏统计有效性。RoboArena、TRI-LBM、DROID-task及合成数据实验显示，该方法相较于 Bonferroni 等严格统计基线能以更少样本拒绝更多假设，部分场景减少约 50% 的硬件评估，并避免 Bradley–Terry 等启发式排序方法的误校准和时间不一致问题。论文指出，其效果依赖独立同分布评估数据，现有世界模型先验在大规模评估中往往预测性不足。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出 AnyRank，将多机器人策略排序统一为序贯多重假设检验问题，并支持任意停止时刻的部分或完整排序。 2. 将安全任意时刻有效推断与图式多重假设检验结合，在自适应采样和停止条件下控制家族错误率。 3. 设计基于比较难度和当前风险预算的主动采样机制，将更多评估分配给统计上更难区分的策略。 4. 提出利用先验策略性能估计初始化风险分配和图权重的方法，并证明不准确先验不会破坏统计保证。 5. 通过传递闭包进一步推断可由已解决的策略比较推出的排序关系。 6. 在仿真、RoboArena、TRI-LBM 和 DROID-task 等数据上验证了可靠性、样本效率、先验影响和可扩展性。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点的直接联系主要在于动作条件视频世界模型和闭环策略评估：它将世界模型中的策略 rollout 作为硬件评估的先验，用于预测策略相对性能、初始化多重检验图并减少昂贵的真实机器人试验。论文还专门比较了世界模型先验与真实硬件结果的相关性，发现普通或离线世界模型先验可能很弱（一个 RoboArena 实验中 Spearman 相关系数为 0.05），而针对具体任务微调的视频世界模型可获得较强相关性（DROID Fold towel 实验中为 0.89）。因此，该工作不是视频生成模型本身，也不提出视频扩散、长视频生成、实时生成、蒸馏、稀疏注意力或缓存复用算法；其贡献是为动作条件视觉世界模型产生的模拟结果提供一种统计上可靠的硬件闭环验证和策略排序框架。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确假设评估数据是独立同分布的；当任务、环境或 rollout 存在相关性时，统计保证可能不适用。可靠地利用先验以进一步减少硬件评估仍然具有挑战性。实验表明，现有模拟器和开箱即用的视频世界模型在大规模评估中通常不足以准确预测真实策略性能。即使先验较强，可靠的硬件策略比较仍可能需要较多评估，代理评估与硬件评估的高效、可靠融合被留作未来工作。随着策略数量增加，待比较的策略对数量呈二次增长，排序的固有难度和样本复杂度仍会上升。
papers.abstract_cn: 由于硬件实验成本高昂，机器人策略通常通过在有限次数的硬件试验中比较其经验性能来进行评估。然而，有限样本的统计不确定性可能导致错误结论，尤其是在使用固定批量评估数据对多个策略进行排序时。我们提出 AnyRank：一种用于多策略排序的序贯方法，它（i）自适应地为难以区分的策略分配试验；（ii）能够在任意停止时刻提供（部分）排序，同时控制排序错误的概率；（iii）可选择利用先验信息，更高效地安排硬件评估。这些先验信息可以来自专家直觉、少量留出的硬件评估，或来自模拟器和动作条件视频世界模型中的策略 rollout。值得注意的是，先验可以是不完美的；尽管强先验能够提高硬件评估效率，但先验策略排序中的任何错误都不会破坏 AnyRank 的统计保证。我们通过结合序贯检验与多重假设图检验的新理论贡献，实现了上述性质。在仿真和真实世界策略评估基准上的实验表明，与现有具有严格统计保证的方法相比，AnyRank 最多可减少 50% 的硬件评估次数，同时能够避免当前最先进基准所使用的启发式方法产生的错误排序。

papers.title: VDOT++: Unified Few-Step Video Generation via Unbalanced Optimal Transport Distillation
papers.abstract: Video creation spans text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and condition-based generation, yet video diffusion models remain costly because they repeatedly evaluate large backbones during sampling. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) reduces this cost, but its reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective can provide unstable or incomplete guidance when the student and teacher distributions have limited overlap. VDOT addressed this issue by adding optimal transport distillation (OTD), whose explicit coupling supplies geometric directions for condition-based generation. Balanced OTD, however, performs full-mass matching between the spatial tokens of each corresponding student--teacher frame pair. This assumption weakens for T2V and I2V, where one condition admits many valid outputs and spatial content need not align across different realizations. We present VDOT++, a unified distillation framework that applies the same training recipe separately to generators for the three task families. It makes OTD robust to output diversity through an asymmetric unbalanced formulation that allows unreliable student tokens to carry less mass while maintaining coverage of the teacher tokens. An $\ell_1$ ground cost further replaces mean-based aggregation with a more mode-preserving weighted median that limits the influence of distant transport targets. The two changes respectively determine whom to match and how the selected targets should be aggregated. We additionally combine distribution matching and adversarial refinement through sequential backward passes, and exploit the decoupled score networks for cross-scale distillation, where larger score networks improve a compact generator. Experiments on UVCBench, VBench, VBench-I2V, and the VACE benchmark show that the resulting four-step generators are competitive with many-step teachers and strong few-step baselines across all three task families.
papers.summary_cn: Video creation spans text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and condition-based generation, yet video diffusion models remain costly because they repeatedly evaluate large backbones during sampling.
papers.contribution_cn: We present VDOT++, a unified distillation framework that applies the same training recipe separately to generators for the three task families.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：video generation, efficient generation；关键词：few-step, distillation, video generation, text-to-video, image-to-video, video diffusion
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon Robotic World Models
papers.abstract: Autoregressive robot video world models based on discrete visual tokens remain unreliable over long rollout horizons. Retaining the entire generated history does not necessarily improve prediction quality. We investigate a possible memory-role conflict in Full Context decoding: persistent scene information, recent visual-action states, and stale generated history compete for attention despite their different predictive roles. This perspective motivates ReCAP (Receding Context with Anchor Preservation), a training-free context-scheduling method for long-horizon robot video world models. ReCAP keeps the pretrained tokenizer, world model, and visual decoder frozen. It preserves the initial scene anchor and a contiguous window of recent complete visual-action blocks while evicting older generated history. The schedule preserves within-block structure and temporal order, requires no additional modules or parameter updates, and bounds active-context growth independently of rollout length. We evaluate ReCAP on RT-1, BridgeV2, LIBERO-90, and CALVIN using frozen autoregressive world models. Across evaluated environments and horizons, ReCAP improves visual fidelity, action-conditioned consistency, and robot structure preservation relative to Full Context. On BridgeV2, it reduces LPIPS by 63.3%. In the system benchmark at H=64, it reduces the logical KV footprint by 73.3% and p50 latency by 6.51%. Attention analyses show increased attention to retained recent states, while history interventions associate larger amounts of stale context with higher prediction error. These observations are consistent with the memory-role-conflict hypothesis, although they do not isolate it from context-length and position-handling effects. Our results support inference-time context scheduling as a practical approach to improving long-horizon robot video prediction and computational efficiency without retraining.

papers.title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.

papers.title: Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables long-horizon synthesis but requires repeated forward passes through large diffusion transformers. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation, yet existing controllers often couple two decisions: when to synchronize the cache exactly and how much computation to repair between synchronizations. We introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC), which separates these roles. FSC schedules exact full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse trajectory, while a lightweight latent-space risk based on frequency-resolved drift and token age controls inter-anchor repair through whole-step replay, selective token recomputation, or full repair. On SkyReels-V2, whole-step reuse provides most of the acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. A controlled ablation shows that using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the same separation advantage observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple autoregressive video backbones, FSC improves speed-quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches 2.36x speedup versus MotionCache's 2.275x while improving SSIM by 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 dB. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 dB and lowers LPIPS by 0.024. Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to SkyReels-V2 14B at 2.12x speedup versus 1.79x for MotionCache.

papers.title: FrameFold: Response-Guided KV Cache Consolidation for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
papers.abstract: In autoregressive video generation, retaining all historical key-value (KV) states increases memory usage and per-step attention costs as videos grow longer. A fixed cache budget bounds these costs but raises the challenge of preserving historical content that supports consistent, high-quality generation. Existing methods control cache size through history selection or consolidation, yet deciding what to retain and how to limit the loss of useful content remains a shared challenge. Our analysis shows that spatial queries depend on different historical content and that higher current attention coverage does not necessarily yield better long-video quality. We introduce FrameFold, a training-free KV cache consolidation method that compares the content retrieved by the same recent historical queries before and after merging to guide both representative construction and merge selection. Exploiting temporal redundancy between adjacent historical entries, FrameFold merges their KV states into shared representatives while retaining complete spatial grids. It fits value-merging coefficients in closed form by matching conditional attention responses, then selects the merge with the lowest remaining response distortion. Under matched KV cache budgets, experiments on Self Forcing and Causal Forcing at 30 and 60 seconds and on LongLive at 120 seconds demonstrate improved consistency and visual quality. Continuous eight-minute Self Forcing rollouts further show less quality degradation than the baselines.

papers.title: ProWorld: Multi-View World Model with Proprioceptive Feedback for Closed-Loop Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: Evaluating robot manipulation policies through repeated physical trials is costly. We study whether an action-conditioned world model can serve as a closed-loop test environment whose policy success rates track those on real robots. Beyond realistic video, the model must return the camera views and proprioceptive state needed for the policy's next action and preserve failed-action outcomes to avoid overestimating policy capability. We introduce ProWorld, a world model that jointly predicts multi-view video and robot state, then feeds both back to a frozen policy for repeated interaction. ProWorld comprises a shared transformer for joint video-state flow prediction and Shared-Time View Encoding to distinguish cameras while preserving temporal synchronization. To reduce interaction hallucinations that turn missed grasps into successful lifts, we augment training with failed interactions collected in high-fidelity simulation, reducing inflated success rates in the generated environment. ProWorld achieves the highest overall TriWorldBench score among the compared methods. Across three policies and four local manipulation tasks, it attains a Pearson correlation of 0.95 and a Spearman correlation of 0.94 between generated and real success rates. These results support joint visual-proprioceptive feedback and failure-aware training as a basis for world-model-based policy evaluation.

papers.title: Towards Safe World Models: Risks, Defenses, and Evaluation
papers.abstract: World models support planning, control, learning from imagined experience, and model-mediated evaluation by predicting action-conditioned consequences. Their safety cannot be inferred from predictive accuracy alone: errors in observations, state and memory, dynamics, evaluation, execution, or feedback can propagate into unsafe decisions and persist through updates. This work organizes the literature on world-model safety around a six-stage lifecycle covering data and observations, state and memory, dynamics and imagination, evaluation and planning, action and control, and feedback and update. We synthesize non-adversarial failures, attacks, defenses, evaluation protocols, benchmarks, and deployment conditions, and distinguish evidence directness from outcome level. The current evidence corpus contains 163 cited works. We use the framework to identify where claims are supported, where attribution remains unresolved, and which measurements are needed to connect model-level behavior to closed-loop and operational safety.
